title: 13th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/13/1/2025).
First reading of the Bill amending the Maldives Tourism Act (Law No. 2/99), submitted on behalf of the government by Thimarafushi MP Ahmed Riyaz.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Maldives Tourism Act (Law No. 2/99), submitted on behalf of the government by Thimarafushi MP Ahmed Riyaz.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador to the Republic of the Philippines.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced and began debating the government's Tourism Act amendment bill and took up the committee report on the ambassador nominee for the Philippines.
